note: Splunk BOTS v1/v2/v3 sourcetype -> parser and field allowlist for benchmark_import_bots.py. events: {type key or "*": {field path: transform}}; "prefix.*" covers every leaf under prefix and "*" every other leaf. events_from reuses the OTRF channel allowlist (otrf:<channel>) or the attack_data format allowlist (attackdata:<format>); listed events override it. metadata_only: fields kept for a parsed record whose type has no entry. Unlisted fields are dropped and counted; unknown sourcetypes and unparsed records are metadata-only events. hex_argv: json field paths holding an audit-style argv (hex-encoded words are decoded before sanitizing).
